[SWS_DM_00925] Event memory overflow notifier on occurence
⌈
If
there exists already <maxNumberOfEventEntries> in one of the configured DM
event memories and there is an attempt to store an additional entry to this event
memory, the DM shall each time call the corresponding overflow notification function for
that event memory, which was registered via the function ara::diag::DTCInfor-
mation::SetEventMemoryOverflowNotifier for this event memory instance
of ara::diag::DTCInformation, with the parameter value set to true.
⌋
